findings.reason: the section's stated open question is unresolved by a comparison whose two outcomes both match one of its branches; an independent reference (EFIT's lower X-point, as §10 and §13 already use) must be named, or a null move beyond 1 mm must be recorded as evidence for the second alternative rather than as a failed run.
findings.text: §7's own text leaves two alternatives open ("Either the mask disturbs the solver at the cycling active set, or the unmasked base's convergence leaned on the inactive compensator's image"), and its done-when makes "each row's lower X-point lies within 1 mm of its unmasked solve" the pass condition; under the second alternative the unmasked state is the one the section calls "not a valid equilibrium", so a correct mask must move the lower null outside the band and the node records a failure for the outcome the section itself names as legitimate — the clause has no arm separating a mask that disturbs the solver from an unmasked solution the image carried, and the finite-edge unmasked states the plan now relies on (137D 1.250 cm, 146D 1.791 cm, 146L 4.850 cm, 179L 1.499 cm from EFIT) give no evidence for a 1 mm bound on the mask's effect.

findings.reason: the tolerance decides the node's verdict; either the band is derived from a stated expected movement of the equilibrium under an image the section says should not act (which would be far smaller than 1 mm) or the measure needs a different quantity, and as written the first correct run may fail on a threshold no evidence supports.
findings.text: the 1 mm band has no basis in the plan's own measurement: the recovery record (`docs/evidence/fragments/diiid-vertical-force-balance/diiid-inactive-compensator-recovery.html`) is the only matched masked/unmasked pair the plan cites, and its 137D lower-null offsets differ by 2.9544 mm (10.4798913313 mm unmasked, 7.5254723398 mm masked), about three times the band the done-when imposes; a band tighter than the one measured effect of the change being gated will fail a correct mask, and no finite-edge masked arm exists yet from which 1 mm could be inferred.

findings.reason: a section whose done-when's only named record never landed is either undeclared or under-evidenced, and the plan's evidence trail must name what exists.
